recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. New performer elements that might need PractitionerRole should be handled by future resource-specific work-group trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-13159 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked to support PractitionerRole for ProcedureRequest performer so a practitioner acting in a role, such as surgeon for a department, could be represented. The resolution moved the change to workflow patterns and added PractitionerRole to Request.requester, Event.performer, Request.performer, and Definition.publisher.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN#12374. In git, 5064224bd079b7f4ef4023d3ead9111b57bd8bff is the matching SVN#12374 workflow-pattern commit and shows the requested PractitionerRole additions.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest was later replaced by ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest.requester and ServiceRequest.performer both include PractitionerRole target profiles. The Definition.publisher part of the old resolution was later superseded by Published FHIR-40406, which aligned Definition with CanonicalResource and changed publisher to string.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source already satisfies the requested ProcedureRequest/Request performer PractitionerRole capability.
